objections: Lost-utility argument does not hold: date_of_birth is a required field and is already generalized to birth year, which supplies the 10-year age band for H-U1, so deriving the band from the identity code adds nothing.

Unnecessary disclosure: derive_hetu emits sex as well as age band, while sex is suppressed in this same release as not needed; the derived column reintroduces it for a public, differencing-capable audience.

The code is blank for unidentified and non-resident patients, so a hetu-derived band would also be systematically missing for exactly the rare visitors, making it a worse age source than date_of_birth.
